start.text:
Beware the pretty-water, friend.~ The crystholt water-holes are clear as crystal, drink them, and you'll go clear too.~ Cryst-water may look fresh but slake your thirst on that a crysten-effigy will take your place in no time.~ The shiny-baubles near the ponds should warn enough, beware the crystna. Their fumes turn all to glitter.~
Crystna vines might reach out and snatch you. Beware the cryst-weed.~
May your dream-realms be calm and serene, friend.~ Dream in serenity, friend.~ Yes, I dreamt of this conversation, dream-friend.~ I dreamt of this meet, friend.~ Welcome to the eternal Rhem, dream-friend.~
{{emote|*nibbles on crispy shard-leaf*}}~ {{emote|*nips at crunchy chitin-chips*}}~ Might grab some sacchar-chips from chymero's today.~ I'm craving ollah, friend.~ Amrita over eggs-benedict, the thought makes my bellies rumble.~ Mantra-ray flank steaks, a sprinkle of roe, some cryst-tree sap on the side. The meal-thought is maddening, friend.~ Careful with the mad-honey, friend, the mind-journeys aren't always fun.~ I'm bringing brimberries for my youngers.~ The brimraisin's might reek, but they are divine.~
Beware the blood-pits, friend.~ Pits of anguish amongst the cryst, their amalgam scour the lands, murdering and capturing mortal-flesh. They drag you in and your flesh melds with theirs.~ The blood-pits will take you if you are not careful, friend.~ I grieve, one of our own was dragged into the pits, again. We see their faces amongst the Scouer.~ We lost another to the blood-pits. Why does this dream's cruelty wrought such illness on our lands?~
